_meta.purpose: Curated timezone abbreviation offsets for normalizing Leaguepedia local times. Only entries whose offset can be verified against the IANA database are allowed here. Entries are added one at a time as real fixture data requires them; unknown abbreviations must stay UNKNOWN, never guessed.
sources: IANA tz database (tzdata): Asia/Seoul is a fixed +09:00 zone with no DST (last DST use ended 1988).

KST.notes: South Korea does not observe DST; the fixture's dst=yes flag on KST rows is a data anomaly recorded as a warning, not used for offsets.
